name: home-mosaic.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic.scss — the masonry project grid's VISUAL layer only.
//  ALL geometry (card position/width/height/columns) is computed in JS by
//  HomeMosaic.layout() via WASM math and written as inline styles — this file
//  owns colors, hover states, card chrome, captions and transitions, never
//  layout numbers.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

// ── Home Portfolio Masonry — VISUAL STYLES ONLY ───────────────────────────────
// ALL geometry (position, width, height) is set by layoutMasonry() in Home.vue.
// This file only handles colours, fonts, border-radius, shadows, transitions.

// Shadow host — fills parent width.
:host {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

// Section wrapper — %MAXAREA column.
// padding-top must clear the fixed .nav (top: $space-lg + ~$space-2xl row
// height ≈ 47px) with breathing room — 4xl (89px) keeps the title from
// sliding under the logo/burger on every breakpoint.
.home-portfolio-section {
  @extend %MAXAREA;
  width: 100%;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-4xl);
  padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid transparent;
  border-image: var(--metallic-hairline) 1;
  background-image: var(--filament-glow);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-5xl);
  }

  .home-section-title {
    @extend .ttl-xl;

    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-weight: 100;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-align: left;
    padding-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }
}

// ── Masonry container ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// height is set inline by JS (containerH). Transitioning it makes the about
// section below slide smoothly when a card expands / collapses on hover.
.home-mosaic {
  transition: height 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  // Mobile: skip height transition — triggers layout recalc each frame
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    transition: none;
  }
  min-height: to-rem($space-9xl);

  @include layout-540() {
    min-height: to-rem($space-10xl);
  }
  @include layout-960() {
    min-height: to-rem($space-9xl);
  }
  @include layout-1440() {
    min-height: to-rem($space-8xl + $space-5xl);
  }
  @include layout-1920() {
    min-height: to-rem($space-8xl);
  }
}

// ── Card container ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// position / top / left / width / height are ALL set inline by JS.
.home-mosaic-item {
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  // Always dark — photo cards look wrong on a light background
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  container-type: inline-size; // enables cqw units for child text
  border: none;

  // Smooth transitions — JS changes inline styles, CSS animates them.
  // Desktop: all properties (height/top/left are non-composited but tolerable
  // at desktop GPU speeds).
  // Mobile: only GPU-composited properties — height/top/left transitions
  // trigger a layout recalc on EVERY frame, causing the animation freeze
  // reported on iOS and Android.
  transition:
    height 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    top 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    left 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 0.36s ease,
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    filter 0.3s ease;

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    // Drop layout-affecting properties — keep only compositor-thread properties
    transition:
      transform 0.36s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 0.3s ease;
  }

  &--featured {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-featured);
  }

  &:is(:hover, :focus-visible) {
    transform: translateY(-#{to-rem($space-sm)}) scale(1.015);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover);
    z-index: 10;
    opacity: 1;
    filter: none;

    .home-mosaic-media {
      border-bottom-left-radius: 0;
      border-bottom-right-radius: 0;
    }

    .home-mosaic-img {
      transform: scale(1.07);
    }
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    @include focus-ring;
  }
}

// ── Cover image area ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// height is set inline by JS — this block only handles visuals
.home-mosaic-media {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: inherit;
  overflow: hidden;
  // transition on height so the image area animates when card expands/collapses
  transition: height 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    transition: none;
  }
}

// Card image.
.home-mosaic-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  display: block;
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: transform 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

// Gradient overlay + title shown on hover.
.home-mosaic-title-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-lg);
  background: linear-gradient(
    to top,
    rgba($color-black, 0.88) 0%,
    rgba($color-black, 0.12) 55%,
    transparent 100%
  );
}

// Card title text inside the overlay.
.home-mosaic-title {
  @extend .ttl-sm;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 100;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: $color-white;
  text-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md) rgba($color-black, 0.8);
  margin: 0;
  font-size: to-rem($space-md); // fallback: Safari < 16 / iOS < 16 (no container query support)
  font-size: clamp(to-rem($space-md), 5cqw, to-rem($space-lg));

  .home-mosaic-item--featured & {
    font-size: to-rem($space-xl); // fallback: Safari < 16 / iOS < 16
    font-size: clamp(to-rem($space-md), 5.5cqw, to-rem($space-xl));
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  }
}

// ── Description panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// height is set inline by JS (0 → BOTTOM_H px)
.home-mosaic-bottom {
  // transition on height so panel animates smoothly
  transition:
    height 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.28s ease 0.1s;
  // Mobile: drop non-composited height transition, keep opacity only
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    transition: opacity 0.28s ease 0.1s;
  }
  // Always dark to match card image aesthetic in both light and dark mode
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  border-bottom-left-radius: inherit;
  border-bottom-right-radius: inherit;
  border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.07);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

// Card detail text block.
.home-mosaic-details {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-lg) 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  // height is driven by parent (.home-mosaic-bottom), DO NOT set height here
}

// Card description.
.home-mosaic-desc {
  @extend .txt-sm;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 200;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: rgba($color-white, 0.92);
  text-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-pixel) to-rem($space-2xs) rgba($color-black, 0.7);

  .draw-text__char {
    animation: char-draw 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 8ms));
  }
}

// ── CTA button ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Always white — cards always have a dark background so contrast is guaranteed
// in both light and dark mode.
.home-mosaic-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend .ttl-xs;
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
  color: $color-white;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-top: to-rem($space-md);
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: to-rem($space-sm);
    height: to-rem($space-sm);
    transition:
      width 0.25s ease,
      height 0.25s ease;
  }
  &::before {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.65);
    border-left: to-rem($space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.65);
  }
  &::after {
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-bottom: to-rem($space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.65);
    border-right: to-rem($space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.65);
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus {
    opacity: 0.75;
    &::before,
    &::after {
      width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
      height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
    }
  }
}
